options.name: apply
options.description: Whether this Notification should be an applied Notification.

options.name: apply_target
options.description: Whether this Notification should be a host or a service Notification.

options.name: assign
options.description: List of conditions for where to apply this Notification.

options.name: command
options.description: The name of the notification command which should be executed when the notification is triggered.

options.name: file
options.description: Path to the file in which the object will be defined.

options.name: host_name
options.description: The host this Notification belongs to. There must be a host object with that name.

options.name: ignore
options.description: List of conditions for where to ignore this Notification.

options.name: imports
options.description: List of imports for the Notification.

options.name: interval
options.description: The notification interval.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the Notification object.

options.name: order
options.description: Value to determine internal precedence.

options.name: period
options.description: The name of a time period which determines when this notification should be triggered.

options.name: service_name
options.description: The service this Notification belongs to. There must be a service object with that name.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the Notification object.

options.name: states
options.description: A list of state filters when this notification should be triggered.

options.name: template
options.description: Whether the Notification is a template.

options.name: times
options.description: A dictionary containing begin and end attributes for the notification.

options.name: types
options.description: A list of type filters when this notification should be triggered.

options.name: user_groups
options.description: A list of user group names who should be notified.

options.name: users
options.description: A list of user names who should be notified.

options.name: vars
options.description: A dictionary containing custom variables that are specific to this Notification.

options.name: zone
options.description: The zone this object is a member of.
